name: mod
description: 5dive telemetry producer for Claude Code function hooks (early access). Publishes turn and session boundaries and the account's usage reading from inside the harness process to a per-seat JSONL sink, so the heartbeat, the pacing floor and the self-update's pending-restart sweep can read a first-class signal instead of inferring idle/busy from pane samples and the task board. Observe-only: it never denies, rewrites or delays a call. Off unless the seat opts in.
